title: Assess three plugins: iceberg, ambition lenses and hypotize
why: Owner, Nov 1 21:32 CST: "send a lane to assess whether we should add the plugin iceberg from anthropic and another called ambition lenses, and another called hypotize".
note: Assess only: what each plugin does, overlap with skills already in claude-settings (one home per capability), cost, and a verdict per plugin. No install. When the verdicts return, the add-or-not question goes to the owner after the question check. Lane session_013NEJL4F6AQcHRyHCWa7re4, started Nov 1 21:35 CST. Verdict (record docs/plans/plugin-assess-three.md, draft PR #1036, Nov 1 21:45 CST): skip all three. iceberg is a second prose rulebook that rewrites every plan and doc (prose already has one home: ste-lint and fresh-prose); it is from a community author, not Anthropic. Ambition Lenses is a second rulebook of about 2,000 words loaded into every task (rules have one home: the root CLAUDE.md). Hypotize tracks growth experiments on an outside service; no session here does that work. Nothing installed. Coordinator pick, Nov 1 22:55 CST, process-only: skip all three, as main does; no ste-lint port, since no incident or likely risk is recorded (building-guard-needs-incident). An open record lane adds one line to docs/debts/notes.md: iceberg's "condition first" and "numbers, not 'fast'" rules are ste-lint candidates if an incident shows the need (source PR #1036). Done when #1036 merges. Owner, chat, Nov 1 22:43 CST: b, run the Ambition Lenses A/B trial. This replaces the coordinator's 22:55 skip-all pick for Ambition Lenses; iceberg and Hypotize stay skipped.
